understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation to match each goal cell, then step onto the matching goal. Complete every goal in each level and all levels overall while preserving lives.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and costs one stamina per turn. If stamina reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets. Shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal is completed only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation all match its requirements; the status reports which attribute still differs and where the relevant modifier is located.
